description: List group memberships for a specific Zendesk group. Use when you need to retrieve all members assigned to a particular group, audit group membership, or understand which users belong to a specific support group. This action is read-only and idempotent. Supports both offset pagination (page, per_page) and cursor pagination (page_size, page_after, page_before). Also supports sideloading users and groups via the include parameter.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing group memberships for a specific Zendesk group.

group_id.description: The numeric ID of the group to retrieve memberships for. This is the group ID, not a membership ID.
group_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Zendesk group whose memberships you want to list. This is the group ID, not the membership ID.
group_id.title: Group Id

include.description: Sideloads to include in the response. Accepts a comma-separated list of values. Valid values: `users`, `groups`.
include.human_parameter_description: Include additional data like users or groups. Accepts comma-separated values like 'users,groups'.
include.title: Include

page.description: Page number for offset pagination (starts at 1). Cannot be used with cursor pagination.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Start at 1. Cannot be used with cursor pagination.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor for fetching next page in cursor pagination. Use with page_size. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from previous page for pagination. Use with page_size.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor for fetching previous page in cursor pagination. Use with page_size. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token to go to previous page. Use with page_size.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use with page_after. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Number of records per page using cursor pagination. Use with page_after. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_size.title: Page Size

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page (max 100).
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many membership records to show per page. Up to 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order. Example: `?sort=user_id` or `?sort=-created_at`
sort.human_parameter_description: Field to sort results by. Prefix with - for descending. Examples: user_id, created_at, -created_at.
sort.title: Sort
